Storage: Storage refers to your local folder for holding your scripts that will be automatically copied into your $HOME/.local/bin or $VENV/scripts
This adds it your PATH, applies chmod +x, and to your activated VenV for python it adds to sys.path so you can call them from any location
bashFolder: This is the folder where your bash scripts are stored
It is automatically copied to $HOME/.local/bin and chmod +x is applied
This is also adds it to your PATH
If you update a script, simply cly close this session and start a new one
pyFolder: This is the folder where your python scripts are stored
It is automatically copied to $VENV/scripts and chmod +x is applied
This is also adds it to your PATH
If you update a script, simply deactivate and 'source $VENV/bin/activate' again
Venv: This is the virtual environment Autux created for you
You can create more by copying the VenV key below and changing the path to a legable /data/data/com.termux/* address
datetime must be with all Autux Environments for logging
You can add dependencies to the pre-configured VenV key, but do NOT change its path!
